name: ProbonoSEO Basic
author: probonodesign

sections.description:
You installed a foreign-made SEO plugin, but between the half-English settings screen and the endless switches, you never figured out what to actually configure — so it just sits there, half set up.

You run a Japanese-language site, yet the tool wasn’t built for Japanese text. Character-count guidance is tuned for English, there are countless options, and you can never quite tell whether any of it is actually working on your Japanese posts. Before long you’re spending more time configuring the SEO tool than doing SEO. ProbonoSEO Basic exists to end exactly that.

ProbonoSEO Basic is a free, made-in-Japan SEO plugin that starts working automatically the moment you activate it. No expertise, no long setup wizard. The essentials for a Japanese-language site are simply on.

Tired of this with foreign-made SEO plugins?

  • Too many options — you can’t tell which ones to touch
  • Character-count and separator optimization assume English, so it never matches how Japanese actually looks
  • Getting real value out of it requires tutorials, or a paid course
  • Yearly renewal fees and monthly subscriptions that keep piling up
  • It claims to do dozens of things, yet you can’t feel what is actually working

The more a tool competes on feature count, the deeper the configuration swamp gets. ProbonoSEO Basic chose the opposite path.

With ProbonoSEO, you just install and activate

ProbonoSEO Basic ships with the commonly used basics already switched on. Title optimization, automatic meta descriptions, canonical URLs, structured data (schema), breadcrumbs, internal links, and page-speed groundwork all start working the instant you activate it.

There are only two steps:

  1. Install the plugin
  2. Click “Activate”

That’s it — the SEO foundation for your Japanese-language site is in place. You can fine-tune every switch in the admin screen if you want, but it is designed so that doing nothing still works correctly from the start.

How it differs from a typical foreign-made SEO plugin

We won’t name names, but the differences from a typical foreign-made SEO plugin are clear.

  • Setup burden — Typical foreign-made plugins ask for a lot of upfront configuration and learning before they pay off. ProbonoSEO Basic assumes the basics are auto-on and that it should “work without being configured.”
  • Fit for Japanese — Whether the tool is built around Japanese text structure: character-count feel, separators, and natural summaries. ProbonoSEO Basic was designed from scratch for Japanese-language sites.
  • Cost — Many foreign-made plugins lock their better features behind a monthly or yearly subscription. ProbonoSEO Basic is free, with a one-time (buy-once) philosophy. Costs don’t grow with every renewal.
  • Data handling — ProbonoSEO Basic sends no data to external servers and collects no usage statistics. Everything stays inside your site.

Why “Japanese optimization” actually matters

In the end, SEO quality comes down to one thing: does it read naturally as Japanese? ProbonoSEO Basic solves that concretely.

  • Titles and meta descriptions — Automatically tuned to a length that won’t get truncated in search results (meta descriptions around 70–120 characters). It picks the best separator for Japanese and tidies up full-width/half-width characters and symbols.
  • Natural summaries from your content — It generates a natural Japanese description from the article body, smoothing conjunctions and sentence endings. Even when the excerpt field is empty, you still get a search-ready description.
  • Automatic duplicate avoidance — Detects duplicate titles and descriptions and warns you, reducing the risk of diluted ranking signals.

“Reads naturally in Japanese” — that obvious-but-overlooked baseline is guaranteed with zero configuration.

Built for the age of AI search

Search is rapidly shifting from a list of links to AI that generates the answer. Whether you get cited and referenced by AI search — ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overview — will increasingly decide your traffic.

ProbonoSEO Basic meets that shift head-on (AIO = AI Optimization).

  • Allow AI crawlers — Automatically appends major AI crawlers such as GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, and Googlebot-Extended to robots.txt (it never rewrites existing rules — it only appends at the end). This makes your site available for AI to read.
  • Structured data output — Emits FAQ (FAQPage), Article, and Organization structured data so AI can accurately understand and quote your content.

Search-engine optimization and AI-search optimization, handled by a single plugin — both with nothing more than “activate.”

What changes after you install it

  • Just publishing a post automatically produces search-ready titles, descriptions, and structured data
  • Shares on social platforms (Facebook, X, LINE) keep their intended appearance
  • Breadcrumbs and internal links convey your site structure and improve navigation
  • Lazy-loading for images/iframes and script optimization lay the groundwork for faster pages
  • AI crawlers and structured data prepare your content to be picked up by AI search

The time you used to spend wondering “what do I need to configure for SEO?” goes back to writing.

Mostly automatic — so configuration stays minimal

ProbonoSEO Basic includes many features (74 items), but the number isn’t the selling point. What matters is that nearly all of them work correctly and automatically from the start. So there are very few switches you actually need to look at. Read the list below as “what’s already working behind the scenes.”

Title optimization (7)
Title-tag optimization, separator settings, site-name append, title/H1 consistency check, category-name append, duplicate-title avoidance, symbol & emoji tidying

Meta description (7)
Automatic generation, content extraction, key-term prioritization, natural Japanese summarization, forbidden-phrase removal, length optimization, duplicate check

Canonical (5)
Basic canonical, automatic generation, trailing-slash normalization, www normalization, parameter removal

OGP / Twitter (12)
OGP output, OGP title/description, automatic OG image, fixed OG image, Facebook optimization, LINE preview formatting, thumbnail optimization, image-size detection, alt priority, Japanese-URL support, Twitter card

Schema / Breadcrumbs (16)
Structured data (Article, WebSite, WebPage, Organization, Person, BreadcrumbList, SearchAction, ImageObject) and breadcrumbs (home, category, tag, post, page, archive, search, 404)

Internal links / Speed (12)
Prev/next, same-category, child-page and related-post links, tag relation logic, external-link nofollow, category-link format, image/iframe lazy loading, CSS/JS minification, core-script optimization

Article SEO (6)
Heading structure, image alt, image count, word count, category match, and tag-duplicate checks

Site diagnosis (3)
Title-duplicate diagnosis, meta-description-duplicate diagnosis, page-speed quick check

AIO / AI search (4)
AI-crawler permission (automatic robots.txt append), FAQ Schema, Article Schema, Organization Schema

Other (2)
Unnecessary meta-element cleanup, Google Search Console verification code

Free and one-time — all of it

Everything above is free. No monthly subscription, no yearly renewal fee. “Try it free first, confirm it fits my site, then decide” — being able to make that call is the real value of a buy-once philosophy. Use it to build your site’s foundation without worrying about creeping costs.

Why you can use it with peace of mind

  • No data collection — No data is sent to external servers and no usage is tracked. Everything stays within your site.
  • Automatic conflict avoidance — Even if another SEO plugin is already installed, ProbonoSEO Basic automatically detects it and suppresses duplicate output, avoiding trouble when switching or running side by side.
  • Continuous development by Japanese developers — Built and maintained by developers who understand Japanese-language sites, keeping pace with WordPress core updates.

When you want to go further (Pro)

When you need AI-powered SEO assistance, competitor analysis, or more advanced rich snippets, a separate Pro version is available. See https://seo.prbn.org. Even the Basic version is more than enough to put a solid SEO foundation under your Japanese-language site.

Just install it and try

SEO isn’t something you “perfect before you start” — it’s about getting the right foundation in place quickly and then keeping writing. ProbonoSEO Basic gives you that foundation with nothing more than activating it. Free, buy-once, and no data collection. There’s nothing to lose.

Install it and press “Activate.” From that day, your Japanese-language site starts moving toward being picked up by search — and by AI search.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin and upload the ZIP file (or search for “ProbonoSEO” under Add New).
  2. Click “Activate” from the Plugins list.
  3. The basic SEO features now run automatically. No configuration required.
  4. Only if you want to fine-tune, open the “ProbonoSEO” menu in the admin dashboard and adjust the switches.
sections.faq:
Can I really use it without any configuration?

Yes. The commonly used basics are activated in the on state from the start. Just install and click “Activate,” and the essential SEO for a Japanese-language site begins running automatically. Fine-tuning is available via switches but never required.

Is this for Japanese websites?

Yes. ProbonoSEO Basic is designed and optimized from scratch for Japanese-language sites, built around Japanese text structure (character-count feel, separators, natural summaries).

Does it support AI search (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overview, etc.)?

Yes. By automatically allowing major AI crawlers in robots.txt and outputting FAQ / Article / Organization structured data, it prepares your content to be cited and referenced by AI search.

Is it Made in Japan?

Yes. It is developed and continuously maintained in Japan by Japanese developers.

Can I use it with other SEO plugins?

Yes. ProbonoSEO Basic automatically detects other SEO plugins and suppresses duplicate output to avoid conflicts. That said, we recommend running only one SEO plugin.

Does it cost anything?

The Basic version is free and buy-once. There is no monthly subscription and no yearly renewal fee.

Does this plugin collect user data?

No. The Basic version does not collect data or send anything to external services.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes. It works with any standard WordPress theme. Highly customized themes may require minor adjustments.

What schema types are included in the free version?

WebSite, WebPage, Organization, Person, Article, BreadcrumbList, SearchAction, ImageObject, and FAQPage.

screenshots.caption: Main admin screen (Title Optimization). Just install and activate — the commonly used basics are all on from the start. No expertise and no configuration needed to put your SEO foundation in place.

AIO / AI search. Allow major AI crawlers such as GPTBot, ClaudeBot, and PerplexityBot, and output FAQ, Article, and Organization structured data — getting your content ready to be cited by AI search in one click.
OGP / Twitter. Automatically tidies how shares look on Facebook, X (formerly Twitter), and LINE. Items that often clash with themes or other plugins are intentionally off by default for safety.
Meta description (Japanese optimization). Automatically generates a natural Japanese description from your content and tunes it to 70–120 characters so it won't get truncated in search results.
Site diagnosis. One-click check for duplicate titles, duplicate meta descriptions, and page speed. See your site-wide SEO status and what to improve at a glance.
Plugin info. Free, buy-once Basic edition with no external transmission and no data collection — confirm the safe state you're running in anytime.
